The '''Vagaari slaver fleet''' was the [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Vagaari Empire]] used to enslave various [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and repurposed their [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] into [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] for the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] while the native species were turned into slaves, being used as free labor and [[Zero-g plastic bubble|living shields]]. 

==History==
The Vagaari slaver fleet<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> [[Battle of Geroon|attacked]] and turned the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geroon]] into a colony and enslaved the native [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. During the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the fleet, [[Commander/Legends|led]] by the [[Miskara|ruler]] of the Vagaari, [[Unidentified Miskara (Jorj Car'das)|The Miskara]], was informed of the existence of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and therefore, traveled to the location of a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Picket Force Two/Legends|task force]], where the Vagaari [[Battle for Outbound Flight|attempted]] to seize 6 [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|dreadnaughts]] which were attached to a [[Central Storage Core|storage core]], which was, ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

However, The Miskara, and [[Jorj Car'das]], who had informed the Vagaari of the droids, acting as the translator of the Vagaari with the ''Outbound Flight'', attempted to negotiate with the mystical [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] aboard, however, although Car'das spoke the Jedi's language, [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Jorus C'baoth]], the commander of the expedition ignored their attempt. And shortly after, utilized a [[Force-meld|Force meld]] on all the Vagaari on the warships, destroying their minds slowly. Although the Vagaari had been neutralized, as the Jedi focused on the alien fleet, the Chiss used [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], droid starfighters, on the Vagaari's hulls, firing with enough precision to shoot through the hulls without touching the living shields containing the Geroon. The Miskara and the warships' crew was ultimately killed, as well as the Jedi, however, a portion of the Vagaari fleet escaped, avoiding Thrawn's attempt to destroy them.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

The fleet consisted of fewer than one hundred [[Vagaari warship|warships]], and fewer than one hundred [[Vagaari starfighter|Vagaari fighters]]. It also contained a hundred [[Transport/Legends|Vagaari civilian transports]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagaari fleet appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
